# mtncloud_cypher (Data Source)

Reads one key from Cypher, MTN Cloud's secret store, on any mount: `secret/`, `tfvars/`, `password/`, `uuid/`, `key/` or `vault/`. The key must exist: this data source never creates one (reading a missing `password/`, `uuid/` or `key/` key in the console creates it). The value is stored in Terraform state, marked sensitive: protect your state. To list keys without their values, use `mtncloud_cyphers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key must already exist; its value is stored in state, marked sensitive.
data "mtncloud_cypher" "db" {
  key = "secret/db-credentials"
}

# An object stored on the secret/ mount: read one entry.
output "db_user" {
  value     = data.mtncloud_cypher.db.values["user"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The full key, starting with its mount, for example `secret/db-password` or `password/20/app-admin`.

### Read-Only

- `expire_date` (String) When the lease ends (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `lease_timeout` (Number) Lease in seconds; the key is removed when it ends.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The decrypted value. For an object stored on the `secret/` mount, the object as JSON (see `values`).
- `values` (Map of String, Sensitive) The entries of an object stored on the `secret/` mount; empty for a string value.
